## Present-day Tidal Swamp Suitability Elevation Bands

```{r}

# ============================================================
# TIDAL SWAMP ELEVATION ANALYSIS
# Present-day MHHW and SLR / Landward Migration Zone scenarios
# ============================================================

## load packages & install if needed

# required packages for analysis
required_packages <- c("terra", "sf", "dplyr", "tmap") 

# Check for missing packages and install them
missing_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(missing_packages)) install.packages(missing_packages)

# Load the libraries
invisible(
  lapply(
    required_packages,
    library,
    character.only = TRUE
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. SET PROJECT PATHS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Change to local project files
project_dir <- "H:/Tidal Swamp Elevation Analyses/SpruceSwamp_Restoration_Elevation-Analysis"

dem_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "dems")
mhhw_file <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "mhhw", "mhhw_navd88_m.tif")
estuary_file <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "data",
  "OR_Estuary_Boundaries.gpkg"
)

# Update to estuary of interest name on Estuary Boundaries geopackage 
estuary_layer <- "Nehalem_River"

# Create output folders
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "outputs")
intermediate_raster_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "intermediate rasters")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(intermediate_raster_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. READ AND MOSAIC DOGAMI DEM TILES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dem_files <- list.files(
  dem_dir,
  pattern = "\\.(tif|tiff)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(dem_files) > 0)

dem_tiles <- lapply(dem_files, rast)

# Use mean where overlapping DEM cells occur.
# Change fun if DOGAMI documentation recommends another method.
dem_mosaic <- do.call(mosaic, c(dem_tiles, fun = "mean"))

writeRaster(
  dem_mosaic,
  file.path(intermediate_raster_dir, "dem_mosaic_original_units.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. READ MHHW AND PROJECT DATA TO ITS CRS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mhhw <- rast(mhhw_file)

# Target CRS = NOAA MHHW raster CRS
target_crs <- crs(mhhw)

# Confirm expected projection:
# Expected: NAD83 / UTM zone 10N (EPSG:26910)
crs(mhhw)

# Reproject DEM to MHHW CRS.
# Bilinear interpolation is appropriate for continuous elevation.
dem_utm <- project(dem_mosaic, target_crs, method = "bilinear")

# Read and project the current estuary extent.
estuary <- vect(estuary_file, layer = estuary_layer)
estuary_utm <- project(estuary, target_crs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. CONVERT DEM TO METERS, IF INPUT DEM IS IN FEET
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Use ONE of the next two lines.
# If DEM is already in meters:

# dem_m <- dem_utm

# If DEM is in US survey feet, COMMENT OUT the prior line
# and UNCOMMENT the next line:

dem_m <- dem_utm * 0.3048006096

names(dem_m) <- "dem_m_navd88"

writeRaster(
  dem_m,
  file.path(intermediate_raster_dir, "dem_m_navd88.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. ALIGN MHHW TO DEM GRID
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Resample MHHW to match DEM resolution, extent, origin, and alignment.
# The DEM should have 0.914-m cells after processing.
mhhw_aligned <- resample(mhhw, dem_m, method = "bilinear")

names(mhhw_aligned) <- "mhhw_m_navd88"

writeRaster(
  mhhw_aligned,
  file.path(intermediate_raster_dir, "mhhw_aligned_to_dem.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Optional QA checks:
compareGeom(dem_m, mhhw_aligned, stopOnError = FALSE)
res(dem_m)
res(mhhw_aligned)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. PRESENT-DAY: CALCULATE ELEVATION RELATIVE TO MHHW
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Positive values = elevation above MHHW.
# Negative values = elevation at/below MHHW.
dem_minus_mhhw <- dem_m - mhhw_aligned
names(dem_minus_mhhw) <- "elevation_above_mhhw_m"

writeRaster(
  dem_minus_mhhw,
  file.path(intermediate_raster_dir, "dem_minus_mhhw_m.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Limit current-condition analysis to the present estuary extent.
dem_minus_mhhw_estuary <- mask(
  crop(dem_minus_mhhw, estuary_utm),
  estuary_utm
)

writeRaster(
  dem_minus_mhhw_estuary,
  file.path(intermediate_raster_dir, "dem_minus_mhhw_estuary_m.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. PRESENT-DAY: RECLASSIFY ELEVATION ZONES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Classes use meters above MHHW:
#   1 = 0–10 cm
#   2 = >10–20 cm
#   3 = >20–30 cm
#   4 = >30–40 cm
#   5 = >40 cm
#
# Values below 0 m remain NA.
#
# The third column is the new class value.
present_rcl <- matrix(
  c(
    0.00, 0.10, 1,
    0.10, 0.20, 2,
    0.20, 0.30, 3,
    0.30, 0.40, 4,
    0.40, Inf,  5
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

present_classes <- classify(
  dem_minus_mhhw_estuary,
  rcl = present_rcl,
  others = NA,
  right = TRUE,
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

names(present_classes) <- "mhhw_elevation_class"

# Attach readable class labels.
levels(present_classes) <- data.frame(
  id = 1:5,
  elevation_class = c(
    "0-10 cm above MHHW",
    ">10-20 cm above MHHW",
    ">20-30 cm above MHHW",
    ">30-40 cm above MHHW",
    ">40 cm above MHHW"
  )
)

writeRaster(
  present_classes,
  file.path(intermediate_raster_dir, "present_day_mhhw_elevation_classes.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. PRESENT-DAY: CONVERT CLASSES TO POLYGONS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

present_polygons <- as.polygons(
  present_classes,
  values = TRUE,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

present_polygons$scenario <- "Present-day"
present_polygons$slr_m <- 0

writeVector(
  present_polygons,
  file.path(output_dir, "present_day_tidal_swamp_elevation_zones.gpkg"),
  layer = "present_day_zones",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

### Present-day Tidal Swamp Suitability Map Check

```{r intermediate outputs map preview}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  QUICK STATIC MAP PREVIEWS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(3, 3, 3, 5))

plot(dem_m, main = "DEM (m NAVD88)")
lines(estuary_utm, col = "black", lwd = 1)

plot(mhhw_aligned, main = "MHHW raster")
lines(estuary_utm, col = "black", lwd = 1)

plot(dem_minus_mhhw_estuary, main = "Elevation above MHHW (m)")
lines(estuary_utm, col = "black", lwd = 1)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))


```

```{r Current spruce swamp suitability outputs map preview}

# Reproject to lon/lat for tmap basemap display
present_classes_ll <- terra::project(present_classes, "EPSG:4326", method = "near")
estuary_ll <- terra::project(estuary_utm, "EPSG:4326")

# Esri World Imagery base tiles
esri_imagery <- paste0(
  "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/",
  "World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
)

# Esri reference overlay: labels, roads, boundaries
esri_hybrid_labels <- paste0(
  "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/",
  "Reference/World_Boundaries_and_Places/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
)

tmap_mode("view")

tm_basemap(esri_imagery) +
  
  # Your raster or polygons go between imagery and labels
  tm_shape(present_classes_ll) +
  tm_raster(
    style = "cat",
    palette = c("#ff4fa3", "#ffb000", "#00c2ff", "#8a5cff"),
    alpha = 0.65,
    title = "Present-day zones"
  ) +
  
  tm_shape(estuary_ll) +
  tm_borders(
    col = "white",
    lwd = 2
  ) +
  
  # Add labels and roads above your mapped results
  tm_tiles(esri_hybrid_labels) +
  
  tm_layout(
    title = "Present-Day Tidal Swamp Elevation Zones",
    legend.outside = TRUE,
    frame = FALSE
  )
```

## Landward Migration Zone Tidal Swamp Suitability

```{r Sea level rise scenario tidal swamp suitability}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Select LMZ layer only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 0_8_FT == 0.8 ft
# 1_6_FT == 1.6 ft
# 2_5_FT == 2.5 ft
# 4_7_FT == 4.7 ft

lmz_layer <- "1_6_FT"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Lookup table: LMZ layer -> SLR scenario metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

slr_lookup_m <- c(
  "0_8_FT" = 0.24,
  "1_6_FT" = 0.48,
  "2_5_FT" = 0.76,
  "4_7_FT" = 1.42
)

scenario_lookup <- c(
  "0_8_FT" = "SLR_0_24m",
  "1_6_FT" = "SLR_0_48m",
  "2_5_FT" = "SLR_0_76m",
  "4_7_FT" = "SLR_1_42m"
)

if (!lmz_layer %in% names(slr_lookup_m)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "lmz_layer must be one of:",
      paste(names(slr_lookup_m), collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

scenario_name <- scenario_lookup[[lmz_layer]]
slr_m <- slr_lookup_m[[lmz_layer]]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lmz_file <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "OR_LMZ_Zones.gpkg")

output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "outputs", "SLR Scenarios")
intermediate_raster_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "intermediate rasters")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(intermediate_raster_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Read LMZ and crop to DEM extent
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lmz <- terra::vect(lmz_file, layer = lmz_layer)
lmz_utm <- terra::project(lmz, target_crs)

# Use DEM extent as the processing boundary
dem_extent <- terra::ext(dem_m)
dem_extent_poly <- terra::as.polygons(dem_extent, crs = terra::crs(dem_m))

# Crop LMZ to DEM extent only (not estuary boundary)
lmz_dem <- terra::crop(lmz_utm, dem_extent)

if (!inherits(lmz_dem, "SpatVector")) {
  stop(
    "LMZ crop to DEM extent did not return a SpatVector. ",
    "Check that lmz and dem_m are valid spatial objects."
  )
}

if (nrow(lmz_dem) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No LMZ polygons overlap the DEM extent. ",
    "Check DEM extent, CRS, and LMZ coverage."
  )
}

terra::writeVector(
  x = lmz_dem,
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(tolower(lmz_layer), "_lmz_dem_extent.gpkg")
  ),
  filetype = "GPKG",
  layer = paste0(tolower(lmz_layer), "_lmz_dem"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  SLR / LMZ analysis for selected LMZ layer
# ------------------------------------------------------------

future_mhhw <- mhhw_aligned + slr_m
names(future_mhhw) <- paste0("mhhw_", scenario_name)

terra::writeRaster(
  future_mhhw,
  file.path(
    intermediate_raster_dir,
    paste0(tolower(scenario_name), "_future_mhhw.tif")
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

dem_minus_future_mhhw <- dem_m - future_mhhw
names(dem_minus_future_mhhw) <- paste0(
  "elevation_above_future_mhhw_",
  scenario_name
)

terra::writeRaster(
  dem_minus_future_mhhw,
  file.path(
    intermediate_raster_dir,
    paste0(tolower(scenario_name), "_dem_minus_future_mhhw.tif")
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Crop and mask rasters to LMZ within DEM extent
future_mhhw_lmz <- terra::mask(
  terra::crop(future_mhhw, lmz_dem),
  lmz_dem
)

terra::writeRaster(
  future_mhhw_lmz,
  file.path(
    intermediate_raster_dir,
    paste0(tolower(scenario_name), "_future_mhhw_lmz.tif")
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

dem_minus_future_mhhw_lmz <- terra::mask(
  terra::crop(dem_minus_future_mhhw, lmz_dem),
  lmz_dem
)

terra::writeRaster(
  dem_minus_future_mhhw_lmz,
  file.path(
    intermediate_raster_dir,
    paste0(tolower(scenario_name), "_dem_minus_future_mhhw_lmz.tif")
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

suitable_lmz <- terra::ifel(
  dem_minus_future_mhhw_lmz >= 0.20,
  1,
  NA
)

names(suitable_lmz) <- "at_least_20cm_above_future_mhhw"

terra::writeRaster(
  suitable_lmz,
  file.path(
    intermediate_raster_dir,
    paste0(tolower(scenario_name), "_suitable_20cm_above_mhhw.tif")
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

suitable_lmz_polygons <- terra::as.polygons(
  suitable_lmz,
  values = TRUE,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

suitable_lmz_polygons$lmz_layer <- lmz_layer
suitable_lmz_polygons$scenario <- scenario_name
suitable_lmz_polygons$slr_m <- slr_m
suitable_lmz_polygons$criterion <- ">= 0.20 m above future MHHW"

terra::writeVector(
  suitable_lmz_polygons,
  file.path(output_dir, "slr_tidal_swamp_suitability.gpkg"),
  layer = tolower(scenario_name),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

### LMZ Scenario Outputs Map Check

```{r sea level rise scenario tidal swamp suitability map}

suitable_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(suitable_lmz_polygons)
suitable_sf <- sf::st_transform(suitable_sf, 4326)

tmap_mode("view")

tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery") +
  tm_shape(suitable_sf) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "#ff4fa3",   # bright magenta-pink
    fill_alpha = 0.45,
    col = "#fff7fb",    # very light outline
    lwd = 0.5
  )
```
